name: Shanghai Yct Electronics Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Yct Electronics Group Co.,Ltd provides electronic products in China and internationally. The company offers electromechanical and communication equipment, instruments and meters, and computer software and hardware products; imports, exports, and sells goods and technologies; and designs and develops software and hardware products. It also provides in-vehicle infotainment and navigation solutions. The company serves automobile, industry, and electric power industries. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
